title: xDrip+ preventing bluetooth connections
body:
The connection between phone and Dexcom 8G transmitter is absolutely reliable since december.
But since that update, some of my other bluetooth connections became unreliable. For historical reasons I had some BT settings under "less common settings" enabled. That improved the situation. For example, I can now connect phone and car again. The car's BT was shown in BT settings but could not be paired (not even a dialog came up).
My Wear OS smartwatch is, when connected, working very well. When it loses connection to the phone (out of range, restart etc.), reestablishing it can take several hours.

When pairing a new device xDrip os always raised / becomes the active app and the pairing may fail. If the phone is restarted and pairing is initiated quickly (before xDrip is fully initialized?) it will be successful.

comments.body:
@nsghub It looks like you have blocked @Navid200, haven't you?
He and I are screening and tagging all open issues. Afterwards, we will categorize them and assign a severity and priority and maybe create some milestones. Our goal is to get a good overview and restructure the code to fix bugs efficiently and in a timely manner. That's a really boring job and sometimes not satisfying for users. We are improving our communication constantly. Blocking the main supports is not really helpful.
Navid likely knows a combination of settings which could help you. Please unblock them and post your problem in https://gitter.im/jamorham/xDrip-plus, if it is still present. It is very likely that you get help their.
Otherwise, please close this issue.

Please try the latest nightly build.

Closing this issue due to inactivity and likely resolution.
